title: The couple reviews the September accounts together
description: After the meal, she cleared the table and had her eldest son Mingxuan look after his younger brother and sister while they did homework. She took out the receipt folder, family account book, and travel notebook she had organized during the day, and went over the accounts with her husband, Ma Zhiqiang. She first summarized a few large expenses from mid-month, then checked the receipts item by item. When they calculated the education expenses, they found that the itemized figures far exceeded the budget, and the two were silent for a moment. Ma Xiulan wrote in red pen in the account book: 'September education spending over budget,' and marked the overspending. After discussion, they decided to reduce purchases of snacks and unnecessary potted plants starting in October, set aside a fixed 200 yuan from Zhiqiang's salary each month as an 'education emergency fund,' wrote the new rule on the flyleaf of the account book, and set a reminder on the phone calendar for the 'Family Finance Day' at 8 p.m. on the 26th of each month. Then she opened the travel notebook and estimated the high-speed rail, accommodation, meals, and admission ticket costs for the National Day trip to Beijing, and made a note to reserve funds for taking Yuxin to the dentist on October 28.
